checklist: perl -e: $^V is v5.42.0
static XS: List::Util, POSIX, Digest::SHA, MIME::Base64
fork (asyncify): the child's exit status reaches waitpid

@INC as in 5.42.0-6 (flat lib/perl5 and lib/perl5/wasm32-wasix from the manifest PERL5LIB, site_perl, /usr/lib/perl5/site_perl/5.42.0); List::Util loads from lib/perl5; installsitelib; a pure-Perl module written into the site dir loads from there; a caller's PERL5LIB is prepended

64-bit integer formats: XS Data::Dumper (Useperl=0) of [1,{a=>2},-3,2**40], Dumper(1) and IV_MIN+1; printf/sprintf %d %u %x %o %vd of 2**62 / 2**40 / UV_MAX; $Config{ivdformat} uvuformat sPRId64 are lld/llu/lld (pinned in hints: perl-cross took Ld from a glibc host)
file write/read; open -| to a child; perl -ne on stdin; die → non-zero rc and the message

cert/regex.mjs (static ext/re next to the core engine; re_top.h renames perl 5.42's split regcomp helpers instead of --allow-multiple-definition): perl -Mre=debug prints the Compiling/Final program/Matching/Match successful/Freeing trace; use re 'eval' with (?{ }); qr// named captures, %+, re::regname/regnames; \K; lookbehind split; /g list; the same patterns agree with and without re debug; Text::Balanced extract_bracketed; Pod::Simple::Text parse

cert/cwd.mjs (XS Cwd, new in -7): getcwd, cwd, abs_path and File::Spec->rel2abs give /tmp/cw/a/b in a plain directory and through a symlinked directory (physical path, as pwd -P), abs_path resolves the symlink and ..; the same inside a tmpfs mount (wasm-mount: mount -t tmpfs none /mnt/t), where -6's pure-Perl getcwd/cwd returned empty; getcwd is the XS one
require DynaLoader; @ISA = ('DynaLoader') and Fcntl->bootstrap finds the static boot (the real DynaLoader since 5.42.0-13, patches/0006; up to -12 boot_DynaLoader was patches/0004's no-op marker)

cert/modes.mjs (wasix-sysroot 2025.9.30-17 + slicc-kernel 1.35.1 slicc_fs): umask returns the kernel's 022; umask 027 → open > gives 640; File::Temp tempfile 600 and tempdir 700; mkdir 0700; chmod 0755 and -x; perl's stat equals coreutils' stat

cert/signals.mjs (5.42.0-9, wasix-sysroot -20's slicc.sigaction_set hook, -19's alarm): $SIG{CHLD} reaps 3 forked children with waitpid(-1, WNOHANG), no zombie left; WINCH, USR1, INT (kill self) and ALRM (alarm 1) handlers each run once; $SIG{TERM}='IGNORE' survives kill TERM; a handler set back to DEFAULT lets TERM end perl (rc 143). On 5.42.0-8 (sysroot -17) slicc-kernel 1.47.1 ran neither $SIG{CHLD} nor $SIG{WINCH}

cert/users.mjs (H1 homescoop#207, slicc-kernel >= 1.44.0): $< $> $( getpwuid getgrgid as root '0|0|0,0|root|/root|root' and as kernel.users.add cone '1000|1000|100,1000,1000|cone|/home/cone|cone'; the getgroups stub in wasix-posix-stubs.h is gone (sysroot -20 asks the kernel)

times (5.42.0-10, wasix-sysroot 2025.9.30-27): utime 1000000000, 1100000000 then utime undef, undef sets mtime to now (within 5 s); times() user CPU reaches 0.5 s in a busy loop, system and children's times 0. 5.42.0-9 (sysroot -20): utime undef, undef sets mtime 0 (1970) (NEGATIVE.md)

handles (5.42.0-11): utime with a filehandle sets explicit times and undef, undef sets now (futimes through futimens; up to -10 a stub, EOPNOTSUPP); flock LOCK_EX, LOCK_SH|LOCK_NB and LOCK_UN succeed on an open write-only handle (whole-file fcntl locks from 5.42.0-15, LOCK_SH taken as a write lock on a write-only handle; up to -14 an advisory no-op) and a closed one fails with EBADF (up to -10 every flock failed with EOPNOTSUPP); use filetest 'access' makes -r/-w/-e/-x ask libc's eaccess (wasix-sysroot -25; up to -10 a stub, so -r was false)

prove (5.42.0-11, patches/0005-sselect-wasi-fd-set.patch): prove t/ with a raw-TAP and a Test::More file gives Files=2, Tests=5, Result: PASS; prove -v shows the TAP; a failing test fails prove (Failed test: 2); IO::Select->can_read over two pipes returns the ready one. 5.42.0-10: prove said 'No plan found in TAP output' and can_read trapped (memory access out of bounds)

cert/sigmask.mjs (5.42.0-12, wasix-sysroot -28 signal masks, slicc-kernel 1.93.0): POSIX::sigprocmask(SIG_BLOCK, SIGUSR1) with an empty old mask; kill USR1 => $$ stays pending (POSIX::sigpending), does not run $SIG{USR1} and does not cut select(undef, undef, undef, 0.5) short; SIG_UNBLOCK reports it was masked, the handler runs once and nothing is left pending: 'was=0 slept=1 pending=1 blocked_hits=0 masked=1 hits=1 left=0'. 5.42.0-11 (sysroot -27): 'pending=0 blocked_hits=1 masked=0' (NEGATIVE.md)
cert/wasm-mode.mjs (5.42.0-12): the installed bin/perl.wasm is mode 755 (scripts/command-modes.mjs); 5.42.0-11 shipped it 644

cert/static-xs.mjs (5.42.0-13, homescoop#186 and #188): the real DynaLoader (dl_none.xs, patches/0006): defined &DynaLoader::boot_DynaLoader and &DynaLoader::dl_error, dl_error() is 'Not implemented', bootstrap of a module that is not linked in croaks 'Can't load module Foo::Missing, dynamic loading not available in this perl.', Fcntl->bootstrap finds the static boot; Encode's XS sub-extensions (patches/0007) encode and decode back: UTF-16LE e900ac20 (e-acute, euro), UTF-16BE 00e9, UTF-16 feff0041, UTF-32LE 00f60100, UCS-2BE 007a (Unicode), cp1252 80, koi8-r f6, MacRoman 8e (Byte), symbol 61 (Symbol), cp37 c1 (EBCDIC), euc-cn d6d0, shiftjis 82a0, euc-kr c7d1, big5-eten a4a4 (CN, JP, KR, TW), and each Encode/<sub>.pm loads on demand through find_encoding. 5.42.0-12: Undefined subroutine &DynaLoader::dl_error; Unknown encoding 'UTF-16LE' (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/sigmask-inherit.mjs (homescoop#410; behaviour since 5.42.0-12, wasix-sysroot -28): with SIG_SETMASK {USR1, TERM}, a fork child, a fork+exec $^X child and a system($^X, ...) child all see the mask 10,15; after system('true') and qx(echo hi) the parent's mask is still 10,15 (pp_system restores it), and after clearing it stays empty; a $SIG{USR1} handler that sends itself USR1 sees hits=1 inside and 2 after it returns: 'forkchild=10,15 execchild=10,15 systemchild=10,15 kept=10,15 after=none qx=hi nested_in_handler=1 total=2'. 5.42.0-11: 'forkchild=none execchild=none systemchild=none kept=none ... nested_in_handler=2' (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/locks.mjs (5.42.0-13, wasix-sysroot -30 record locks, homescoop#503): Fcntl's F_GETLK F_SETLK F_SETLKW F_RDLCK F_WRLCK F_UNLCK are 12,13,14,0,1,2; struct flock is pack('s s x4 q q l x4'); the parent's F_SETLK write lock on 0+5 and F_SETLKW read lock on 20+5 succeed, a bad l_type is EINVAL, F_GETLK on its own range answers F_UNLCK. On slicc-kernel >= 1.100.0 (slicc.fcntl_lock, slicc-kernel#722; the cert kernel 1.100.3): a fork child's F_SETLK write on 0+5 is EAGAIN, on 5+5 ok, a read on 20+5 ok, a write on 20+5 EAGAIN, F_GETLK names the parent's F_WRLCK 0+5 and pid; the child's F_SETLKW on 0+5 waits until the parent unlocks 1 s later. Since 5.42.0-14 (homescoop#552) the installed manifest's engines.slicc-kernel is >=1.100.0 and the spec fails closed on an older kernel, which would grant every lock locally (no local-answer branch). 5.42.0-12: 'Your vendor has not defined Fcntl macro F_GETLK' (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/flock.mjs (5.42.0-15, wasix-posix-stubs.h, homescoop#631): as root and as cone, a forked child's LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB and LOCK_SH|LOCK_NB are refused (EWOULDBLOCK) while the parent holds LOCK_EX, the child's blocking LOCK_EX waits for the parent's LOCK_UN (about 1 s), two readers share LOCK_SH while LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB is refused, LOCK_EX on a read-only handle succeeds and keeps a writer's LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB out; a second perl process's LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB prints 'refused: Resource temporarily unavailable' while the first holds LOCK_EX. 5.42.0-14: every flock granted (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/flock.mjs (5.42.0-16, homescoop#757): flock LOCK_EX, LOCK_SH and LOCK_UN on a pipe, on STDOUT through a pipe, on /dev/null and on a directory handle succeed (they exclude nobody: slicc-kernel keeps record locks on regular files only). 5.42.0-15: each failed with EBADF (NEGATIVE.md)

cert/pod.mjs (5.42.0-16, homescoop#491; slicc-kernel 1.106.2, slicc-kernel#762): pod2man --help and pod2text --help print their 'Usage:' (pod2usage reads $0, the /usr/bin entry), and every script command's /usr/bin entry is a readable, non-empty file. On 1.106.1 and older the entries were 0-byte stubs and --help printed nothing

5.42.0-17 (wasix-sysroot 2025.9.30-32 through install-wasixcc; cert/sigaction-inherited.mjs on slicc-kernel 1.108.1 (slicc.sigaction_inherited, slicc-kernel#841), a ci command until a certified kernel has it): under bash trap '' PIPE USR2, exec'd perl's %SIG shows IGNORE for PIPE and USR2 and undef for TERM; without the trap all undef; a $SIG{USR2} handler set over the inherited ignore runs; $SIG{CHLD} = 'IGNORE' reaps a forked child (waitpid -1). 5.42.0-16: undef|undef|undef under the trap (NEGATIVE.md). Every other spec is unchanged on the cert kernel

cert/unix-socket.mjs (homescoop#767, patches/0008): an IO::Socket::UNIX listener on /tmp/perl-unix.sock is -S; its hostpath and unpack_sockaddr_un(getsockname) are the path; a forked client connects, its peerpath is the path, and the line it writes is read from the accepted socket, whose hostpath is the path too. Up to 5.42.0-17 every unpack died: 'Bad arg length for Socket::unpack_sockaddr_un, length is 22, should be 112' (NEGATIVE.md)

5.42.0-19 (wasix-sysroot 2025.9.30-34 through build.sh's HOMESCOOP_WASIX_SYSROOT_VERSION/SHA override, until #984 flips install-wasixcc.sh's default; cert kernel 1.120.2, engines >=1.120.0): flock is libc's (slicc.flock, per open file description) instead of wasix-posix-stubs.h's fcntl emulation. cert/flock.mjs keeps every earlier row: a second open is refused while the parent holds LOCK_EX, blocking waits, shared locks, LOCK_EX on a read-only handle keeps a writer out, as root and cone. It adds two rows. A pipe's read end is refused (EWOULDBLOCK) while its write end holds LOCK_EX, while a forked child's inherited write end shares the lock, and LOCK_UN frees it (#765). The flock(DATA, LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) single-instance idiom refuses a second instance (#758)

cert/mkfifo.mjs (5.42.0-19, #878): POSIX::mkfifo makes a FIFO through libc's mkfifo (slicc_fs.path_mkfifo): -p is true, mode 0644 under umask 022, a second mkfifo is EEXIST, and a forked writer's line reaches the reader. Up to -18, wasix-posix-stubs.h answered mkfifo/mknod with EOPNOTSUPP. The build's WASIX_PERL_STAGE prebuilt path is gone (#864). Config_heavy.pl names the stubs header relative to the repo, so the reproducible job's rebuild in another directory matches (#850)

cert/sigaction-inherited.mjs (moved from the k108 extra-kernel directory, which a ci command ran on slicc-kernel 1.108.1): runs on the cert kernel now, since 1.120.2 has slicc.sigaction_inherited and -19's engines floor is above 1.108.1
